You plan days of errands in San Francisco for people without a car. They travel by Muni (buses, Muni Metro, cable cars), BART, and on foot.

Choose one specific store for each errand and the order to visit them so the person finishes everything as early as possible. Respect store opening hours, the time each errand takes, any deadlines, and when they must reach their final destination. If the errands cannot all be done under those constraints, say so.

Reply with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"feasible": true, "stops": [{"category": "<errand category>", "store_name": "<name>", "address": "<street address>", "poi_id": "<the store's id if ids were given, else null>"}], "reason": null}

- One stop per errand, in visiting order. Use exactly these category names: "bookstore" (bookstore), "bike_shop" (bike shop), "dry_cleaning" (dry cleaner), "pharmacy" (pharmacy), "coffee" (café), "post_office" (post office), "bank_atm" (bank or ATM).
- Give each store's name and its street address in San Francisco.
- If it is impossible, reply {"feasible": false, "stops": [], "reason": "<why>"}.

It's Friday, October 9, and I'm heading out from 24th & Valencia (Mission) around 8:15 am. No car today: just Muni, BART and walking. Today I need to pick up a book I ordered at a bookstore (about 15 minutes), drop off a suit at a dry cleaner (about 5 minutes), grab a coffee at a café (about 10 minutes), drop off a parcel at a post office (about 15 minutes), grab my prescription from a pharmacy (about 10 minutes), get my bike light fixed at a bike shop (about 20 minutes), and get cash from a bank or ATM (about 5 minutes). I have to get my bike light fixed at a bike shop by 9:40 am at the latest. I have to get cash from a bank or ATM by 8:35 am at the latest. When I'm done I'm meeting a friend at Stockton & Clay (Chinatown) and need to be there by 10:45 am. Tell me exactly which stores to visit and in what order so I finish as early as I can. If it can't all be done, tell me it's impossible and why.
